steps.title: The Marvels
steps.text: Valkyrie arrives by the Bifrost to give Carol's Skrull refugees a home in New Asgard.

retag.why: The Marvels never shows New Asgard: Valkyrie arrives by Bifrost aboard Carol's ship, the Hoopty, in space, and takes the Skrull refugees from Tarnax away. New Asgard is not in the film's location list. Tarnax already has The Marvels. Source: https://marvelcinematicuniverse.fandom.com/api.php?action=parse&page=Valkyrie&prop=wikitext&format=json

steps.title: Jessica Jones S3
steps.text: Jessica stops Trish, who is sent to the Raft.

steps.title: Jessica Jones S3
steps.text: Jessica hunts the killer Gregory Sallinger, then stops Trish's killings and sends her to the Raft.

retag.why: Jessica Jones S3 only mentions the Raft: Trish is caught in New York and flown off by helicopter 'destined for the Raft', which never appears. Hell's Kitchen already has the season's entry about Jessica hunting Sallinger. Source: https://marvelcinematicuniverse.fandom.com/api.php?action=parse&page=AKA_Everything&prop=wikitext&format=json
